title: Technical Business Analyst
text: Technical Business Analyst at Investment Administration Services Pty Ltd (Melbourne, CBD & Inner Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). About the business and the role Firm Overview Managed Accounts Holdings Limited is an ASX listed (ASX: MGP) specialist provider of investment administration services with a specialization in managed accounts. Established in 2004, it provides superior administration and technology solutions to some of Australia's leading stockbrokers, wealth managers, and financial advisory firms. Following the merger with Linear Financial, MGP is responsible for funds under administration of over $12.3 billion as at 31 December 2017 and employs over 75 staff. 'MGP' offers clients a superior technology solution through a combination of in-house Australian-based software development and best-of-breed software from external vendors. Team Overview The IT Development Team is responsible for developing and supporting in-house developed solutions to support existing and new business initiatives identified in the company's strategic business plan. The IT Development Team is crucial in providing a practical interconnection of all business areas, including strong relationships with vendors to ensure infrastructure and software availability and uptime. Role A fantastic opportunity exists for an experienced Technical BA to join our Melbourne based operation. The role sits within our IT team supporting both project and new product delivery, primarily focused on software development. The successful candidate will be responsible for working with relevant stakeholders to determine scope, requirements and solutions for assigned projects, engage in User Acceptance testing of implemented solutions as well as provide support across the broader end to end project lifecycle. This includes ensuring user requirements are clearly understood and defined in functional requirement documents as well as participating in discussions about functional design improvements that promote process effectiveness and efficiencies. Job tasks and responsibilities Based in Melbourne CBD Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to gather requirements and prepare detailed specification documents for a variety of new processes and system enhancements Access software testing environments as part of your information gathering process to enhance written specifications on process and system solutions Assist in developing technical solutions that support requirements where applicable Engages in User Acceptance Testing of implemented solutions Coordinate and communicate project delivery by participating in design reviews, walk-throughs and effort estimation Produces and maintains user documentation and/or business process maps and supports training of users as part of Operational Readiness practices. Provide project implementation support, documentation and training Assist in root cause analysis and incident management Participate and contribute to peer development and training Assist in any project based work as instructed by the Head of IT Periodic travel between Melbourne and Sydney Skills and experience Minimum 5 years' experience in or exposure to financial services business functions, preferably in a project environment 3+ years BA experience within established core business requirement gathering skills, UA testing and communication skills. Experience with formal project/software delivery methodologies Proven experience in projects with full knowledge of SDLC in an Agile environment An individual who is curious to learn how existing software works by logging into test environments as a User and self-navigating to learn would be best suited to this role Excellent analytical and problem solving skills An ability to think creatively and suggest innovative solutions to problems where needed Plan, run and facilitate workshops and elicit requirements using mixtures of workshops and one on one meetings Able to deliver multiple streams of complex projects concurrently Demonstrated experience in business process redesign Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with high attention to detail Show pro activeness and ensure deliverables are met with minimal direct oversight Advanced Excel Skills and SQL knowledge is desirable
